name: Elizabeth Elevated

movements.notes: split into 3 unbroken sets per round, each set beginning with a parallel bar traverse

origin.summary: An event from the 2022 CrossFit Games. The CrossFit Games are the season's final championship stage, where the qualified field competes across multiple events to crown the Fittest on Earth. Games events are tests first and workouts second — many use loads, formats, or venues no affiliate would program, which is exactly why they make interesting benchmarks.

description: A descending squat-clean-and-bar-dip couplet, the dips split into unbroken sets each starting with a parallel bar traverse — a harder variant of the classic Elizabeth.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2022/3 (official CrossFit Games event), retrieved 2026-07-09; time cap 10 minutes (men) / 12 minutes (women)
